Name: Less Corrupt Lewis - Lenny's Prank
Author: AirynS
Description:
A simple little mod prompted by a conversation with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/179090667]Logophile[/url] about nicer options on where the solid gold statue might've come from. This is a sister mod to my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14269]Less Corrupt Lewis - No More Statue [/url]mod - this one is funnier, while No More Statue is softer. Pick your preference! The two can't be used together as they affect the same content.

To install, simply extract the "[CP] Less Corrupt Lewis - Lenny's Prank" folder and drop it in your Mods folder.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]! Lewis and Lenny's portraits are their modded variants from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley.
[/url]
The Portuguese translation was created by Kanadeyoru.
